editorial:
Imagine a space hero who spends his days fighting cosmic villains, but then gets stranded in a boring American neighborhood. That is exactly what happens to Shep Ramsey. He has to hide out on Earth while his ship recharges, but there is a catch: he forgot his high-tech power suit back home. Even without his gear, Shep cannot stop himself from playing the hero. You will find it hilarious watching a galactic warrior treat everyday annoyances, like rude paperboys and bad drivers, like they are dangerous alien threats. It is a goofy, lighthearted ride that feels like a Saturday morning cartoon brought to life.

The acting is campy in a way that really works for this kind of story. You get a great mix of silly action and family-friendly humor that keeps the energy high. While the special effects are a bit dated, that actually adds to the charm of the early nineties vibe. If you are looking for a stress-free movie to watch with the kids, this is a great pick.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Shep finally gets his ship back online and ready to fly. He has to use his quick thinking and combat skills to deal with the remaining threats one last time. After cleaning up the neighborhood and teaching the local bullies a lesson, he says a heartfelt goodbye to the people he met. He flies back into deep space, leaving Earth a little bit safer and much funnier than he found it.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy 90s action movies and fish-out-of-water stories.
